I don’t have real‑time access to live exchange‑rate data, so I can’t give you the exact figure for today.  
As a rough guide, if the USD/GBP rate is around **1 USD ≈ 0.78 GBP** (which has been typical in recent months), then:

\[
\$20 \times 0.78 \;=\; \text{£15.60}
\]

So $20 would be roughly **£15–£16**.  

If you need the precise amount for a particular day, you’ll want to check a reliable financial source (e.g., a bank’s website, a currency‑conversion app, or a financial news outlet) that provides up‑to‑date rates.
